NanoSVG parser and rasterizer, unmodified upstream commit
239e102ec2c691f2902e20ace2ed36ee4a35cfe6.
Source: https://github.com/memononen/nanosvg
Zlib license; exact source/license hashes are in ../dependencies.json.
The portable C icon adapter will use its supported SVG path/shape subset.
This is not a complete replacement for GPUI's SVG engine: filters, text and
advanced document features require a host renderer or subsequent implementation.
